title: Compatibility of transport maps
statement:
theorem finiteLocalModels_transport_compatibility
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (U : T.Etale) (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale)
    (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙
      uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj) :
    ∀ (W : T.Etale) (a b : W ⟶ U) (s : E.obj.obj (op W)),
      (finiteLocalModels_transport T E U Q e a.left b.left
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.w a).trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w b).symm)
        (Over.homMk ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down.left
          (MorphismProperty.Over.w ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down))).left =
      ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk b))) s).down.left

proof.text: For an etale source W, let x be the point representing s along a. The lift (x,b) is a morphism of etale T-schemes to R = Q times_T U. Naturality of e along the first map to U and e inverse followed by e show that the universal section pulls back to s: apply injectivity of the component of e, then equality of the underlying Q-points follows from pullback.lift_fst. Naturality of e along the second map to U now identifies the transported point with the point representing s along b.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03RV and 02W5; universal-point form of the Yoneda comparison
proof_origin.note: Direct universal-point construction; section equality is proved from NatTrans.naturality, not from an additional lemma with sorry.

statement_change.old_statement:
theorem finiteLocalModels_transport_compatibility
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (U : T.Etale) (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale)
    (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙
      uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj)
    (transport : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (a b : W ⟶ U.left),
      a ≫ U.hom = b ≫ U.hom →
      (Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk Q.obj.hom) →
      (Over.mk b ⟶ Over.mk Q.obj.hom)) :
    ∀ (W : T.Etale) (a b : W ⟶ U) (s : E.obj.obj (op W)),
      (transport a.left b.left
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.w a).trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w b).symm)
        (Over.homMk ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down.left
          (MorphismProperty.Over.w ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down))).left =
      ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk b))) s).down.left := by sorry
statement_change.what: The old statement quantified over arbitrary transport functions, although its proof description concerns the canonical comparison. Compatibility is false for a nontrivial automorphism of a split two-point finite etale scheme over T=U. Naturality is false for source-dependent choices: use identity on maps from Spec k and compose with the swap on maps from the two-point scheme; restriction along either component then fails. The new statement proves the intended law for the explicit constructed transport.

old_proof.text: The construction is obtained by the fiber-product Yoneda comparison and pullback functoriality described in the parent node.
